sarah: Heads-up: during marlin-48k-int3 bring-up with the new 'digest' priming compression we hit a deterministic quality drop that starts right around token ~32k. Short repro and logs below.

sarah: repro (dev): ```RUNTIME=dev ./run_onboard.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --quant int3 --ctx 48k --priming digest --seed 42 > /tmp/marlin-digest.log 2>&1```

cheng: can you paste a minimal prompt + a good vs bad output snippet?

sarah: minimal chain: system = "You are a strict factual assistant." then ~10k tokens doc history (curated), then a 5k evaluation question.

sarah: no-compress (40k): "Answer: 42. Explanation: ..."
sarah: digest-compress (40k): "I think maybe it's related to something else..."

oliver: big regression. Do we have KV lengths and RoPE metadata at the point of divergence?

sarah: yes: KV entries ~32012, memory stable. Rotary scale per-layer ~0.999.

kate: digest mode collapses spans into summarized KV rows (lossy). Preserves order but re-anchors positions using a stride. If re-anchoring biases positions near window boundaries, RoPE phases can slip.

oliver: looked at code diff: commit 9f3b2a4 in kv_compress: replaced round() anchoring with floor-based anchoring: pos_anchor = (idx // stride) * stride  # floor-anchor (old: round(idx/stride)*stride)

kate: floor vs round introduces systematic negative bias up to 0.5*stride. For high-frequency rotary bases that maps to non-trivial phase offsets -> cancellation at attended positions.

cheng: can we extract attention mass for a token around 31995-32005 before/after compression?

sarah: sanitized logs: [orig] layer10 head3 attn_topk_sum=0.85 tokens 31995-32005; [compressed] layer10 head3 attn_topk_sum=0.11 tokens 31995-32005

oliver: that's consistent with destructive interference. Quick hypothesis: rounding fixes alignment. I'll ask kv-bot to run a compare job replacing floor->nearest in pos anchor.

kv-bot: CI Job queued: onboard-marlin-digest-rounding-compare (owner: cheng). Cluster: jalapeno. Links: https://ci.redwood/org/jobs/3178889999

kate: also flag the quant path: int3 quantization may change accumulation ordering. Add a --quant-skip-reshape run to see if quant reshaping compounds the issue.

cheng: update: preliminary compare: after switching to nearest-anchor the topk attn for layer10/head3 returns to ~0.80 and eval CE drops 3.95 -> 2.12.

cheng: compare artifact: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3178889999/diff.txt

sarah: great. Proposed onboarding note: "digest compression must use nearest-position anchoring to preserve RoPE alignment at long windows; floor anchors can cause phase misalignment and quality regression around 32k+ contexts."

oliver: I'll draft a short onboarding blurb + run a 64k sweep for robustness (CE + example outputs).

kate: followups for PR: (1) revert floor->round in kv_compress and add a unit test that simulates random stride anchoring and asserts max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3; (2) run int3/int4 quant with --quant-skip-reshape to confirm no amplification; (3) add a model-catalog warning to opt-out digest for ctx >= 48k until validated.

cheng: assigned: oliver=doc + 64k bench, sarah=ticket & logs, kate=unit tests. I'll close when the 64k sweep artifacts land. :thumbsup:

kv-bot: Job finished: onboard-marlin-digest-rounding-compare (status: success). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3178889999
